title: myhouse.wad - anyone heard of this?
content: [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=5wAo54DHDY0](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=5wAo54DHDY0) Link to the video on it. It's a Doom mod, and if you're interested in playing these, I'd recommend you just play it first so the surprises aren't spoiled. But since I have never been all that interested in Doom or its mods, I just watched the whole video after a friend recommended it to me. It's been out for over a year now and the video has 11 million views, so I guess I'm just late to the party, but I watched it yesterday and it IMMEDIATELY reminded me of some of my dream worlds. It's based on House of Leaves and the backrooms. I knew about the backrooms but not House of Leaves. I see that book has been mentioned here a couple times, but not this mod. I ordered a copy as soon as it was mentioned in the video, and I'll get it tomorrow. Can't wait to start reading. What do you think of it?
